defects.summary: Inbox (/inbox) and Tickets (/tickets) are two top-level pages listing the same tickets with the same table, so agents cannot tell which one to use for their queue.
The Archive page at /archive is routed but nothing in any nav or page links to it, so users can only reach it by typing the URL.
Canned replies are split between Settings > Macros and Knowledge > Saved replies, two unrelated branches showing the same underlying data.
Plan and billing lives at /reports/billing, reachable only from the Reports page, instead of in the Settings area where users look for account administration.

Ticket status filtering is encoded as a path (/tickets/status/:status) from dashboard cards but as a query (/tickets?status=) in the ticket sub-nav, giving two URLs and two different pages for the same view, with sub-nav active state lost on the path form.
The dashboard Weekly digest shortcut links to /reports/weekly, which has no route, so clicking it does nothing visible (it lands back on the dashboard).
The wildcard route silently Navigates unknown URLs to / so mistyped or removed URLs show the dashboard with no not-found message.
ticketsUrl() concatenates the q value without encoding, so the Related tab link for a company like 'Ferris & Co' produces /tickets?q=Ferris & Co and the search is truncated at the ampersand.
The sidebar Home link goes to /home, which redirects to /dashboard, which redirects again to /, a two-hop Navigate chain.

The top bar and the sidebar are two separate nav systems with different active logic: the top bar Dashboard link has no end match so it is always active, and the sidebar highlights both Inbox and Tickets on /inbox.
The ticket views sub-nav is hidden whenever a ticket id is in the URL, so on a ticket detail page the user loses the contextual navigation back to the filtered lists.
On narrow screens the desktop navs are hidden and the mobile menu lists only Dashboard, Tickets and Customers, so Inbox, Knowledge, Reports and Settings are unreachable from navigation.
The ticket detail breadcrumb says Dashboard / Inbox / #id, pointing at /inbox as the parent even though tickets live under /tickets and are usually reached from there.
The New ticket dialog is held in AppLayout component state with no URL, so it cannot be linked, Back does not close it, and it stays open across navigation.
The reply draft is a single global string in the zustand store, so text typed on one ticket appears in the reply box of any other ticket the user opens.
The conversation/activity/related tabs component is defined inside TicketDetail's render, so changing the ticket status re-renders the parent, remounts the tabs and snaps back to Conversation.

No ScrollRestoration is rendered, so opening a ticket from far down the 60-row list keeps the old scroll offset instead of resetting to top, and returning to the list does not reliably restore position.
Status and search live in the URL but the assignee and sort filters are component state, so after opening a ticket and pressing Back they reset to defaults.
